claim: The largest annual one-day rainfall maxima in Mumbai since 1980, in ERA5, were 301.3 mm on 2020-08-05, 292.0 mm on 2017-09-20, 251.1 mm on 2016-09-22, 234.6 mm on 2011-06-10, and 220.4 mm on 1993-07-03.
